messages:
deploy-bot: Starting v2 rollout to edge proxies in us-west at 10% canary. Deploy ID: dpl-2026-04-02-7f3c. Operators please ack and watch client-pin signals.
maya: ack. I'll watch telemetry and prober dashboards.
jonathan: quick question — are we adding the X-API-Version header gate or relying on client signal?
sasha: adding both. header gate = X-API-Version:v2, and a fallback route for missing header maps to v1.
prod-oncall: noted. I'll set an alert: if downstream 5xx from edge >0.8% for 3m we pause canary and rollback.
maya: seeing a small spike in v2 probe failure in edge-cache (5 failures in 2m) — investigating.
jonathan: do we have a tenant pinlist? some big tenants don't honor header yet, prefer sticky fallback.
sasha: yes, pinlist includes tenant:acme, tenant:beta-inc for v1 stickiness. I'll add tenant:acme to temporary pin to avoid impact.
deploy-bot: Command: ```/deploy dpl-2026-04-02-7f3c --canary 10 --header-gate "X-API-Version:v2" --pin tenant:acme,tenant:beta-inc``` started by sasha
maya: after pin applied probe failures dropped to 1 in 5m. Might be a client charset edge-case hitting the parser.
jonathan: can we hotpatch the header normalization on proxies? small change: casefold header and treat missing as v1 until client releases land.
sasha: we can push proxy shim but prefer to avoid code in canary window. Ops: prefer config toggle?
prod-oncall: agree — config toggle for header-casefold is safer for quick rollback. Rollback criteria reiterated: >1% errors for 10m or client-error rate (4xx) jump >2x baseline.
maya: I'll open an incident if we cross thresholds. For now telemetry looks okay.
docs: heads up — update release notes with the tenant pin list and the header gate instructions. I'll add a short blurb in the v2 changelog and a migration note for SDKs.
jonathan: also notify partner integrations slack — tenants we pinned (acme/beta-inc) should get an FYI that we're gating until they flip.
sasha: posting a small note to #customer-success now.
deploy-bot: Canary reached 10% success = 98.9% s=ok latency within SLO. Continuing slow ramp to 30% in 20m unless manual hold.
prod-oncall: holding an operator watch for 30m. If any tenancy reports a production regression escalate. :eyes:
maya: thanks — keeping dashboard thumb on it.
jonathan: if we need to force rollback the command is: ```/deploy rollback dpl-2026-04-02-7f3c --reason "client regressions"``` — ops please confirm the rollback window and who executes.
prod-oncall: ops will execute rollback if thresholds hit. escalation: prod-oncall -> eng-release oncall -> CTO if >30m unresolved.
docs: release notes updated: added header gate section and tenant pin table. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/release-notes/pull/482
sasha: nice. I'll keep the pin in place for 48h and then evaluate after client patches.
maya: closing watch for now, will post any anomalies. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 30% scheduled at +20m, will abort if any configured alerts fire."
